    Mixed cohook-hook boundary squares #

    The peak/non-peak cases of Butler--Ringel's canonical sequences combine a cohook deletion at one endpoint with a hook at the other. In the right-module convention this is a commuting square with horizontal monomorphisms and vertical epimorphisms. Its associated short complex has the upper-right word as source, the lower-left and upper-right-corner words as middle terms, and the cohook-extended word as target.
